dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: I'm Connor, a winemaker here at Dawn Winery. I've been here since Master Crepus was still in charge.

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: Master Crepus was also Master Diluc's father, the former owner of this winery.

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, Mr. Crepus died in his prime, and now the burden of running the winery falls on Master Diluc's shoulders...

response.speaker: Connor
response.text: Dandelion wine is the signature product of our winery, offering a unique sweetish and refreshing taste, and rich in cereal aroma.

response.speaker: Connor
response.text: As to how it is produced, I suggest you seek the answers in "On Beer Brewing" and "Distillation Technology."

response.speaker: Connor
response.text: They are thoroughly written books and easy to find in the library. But Master Diluc has never read them, not even once...

response.speaker: Connor
response.text: Although Master Diluc appears to have little interest in wine,

response.speaker: Connor
response.text: I believe he bears the same talent in winemaking as his father, only waiting for the right time to reveal itself.

response.speaker: Connor
response.text: The only question is, when will that time come?
